description.value: Jake's at the Lake is a year-round waterfront restaurant on the shores of Lake Cowichan, housed in a classic woody cabin with high ceilings and large windows framing open lake views. Part of the Craig Street Hospitality Group, it serves bold West Coast cuisine with daily seasonal features crafted by an in-house culinary team. The waterfront patio explicitly welcomes boaters, hikers, and families, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Cowichan Valley.

address.value: 109 South Shore Road, Lake Cowichan, BC V0R 2G0

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; rack at 84m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at csbrewery.ca/jakes-at-the-lake is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (109 S Shore Rd, Lake Cowichan, BC V0R 2G0) and phone ((250) 932-2221) exactly. The menu text explicitly lists fried tofu as a protein option in the Korean Kimchi Bowl and Ginger Rice Bowl, confirming at least vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout packaging, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
